description: 35 curated SPPU engineering questions across SPOS, CN, DBMS, and TOC with deterministic golden chunk references and concepts.

cases.subject: SPOS
cases.query: What is the difference between a linker and a loader in system programming?
cases.expected_characteristics: Explanation of linking object files vs loading executable image into RAM.

cases.subject: SPOS
cases.query: Explain relocation in loaders and how memory addresses are adjusted.
cases.expected_characteristics: Details how addresses are adjusted when loaded at different memory base origins.

cases.subject: SPOS
cases.query: What databases are used by a macro processor during Pass 1 and Pass 2?
cases.expected_characteristics: Description of MNT, MDT, and ALA tables across two-pass processing.

cases.subject: SPOS
cases.query: Compare macros and subroutines in terms of code size and execution overhead.
cases.expected_characteristics: Inline expansion vs single shared code copy with call/return overhead.

cases.subject: SPOS
cases.query: List and explain the different phases of a compiler from source to target code.
cases.expected_characteristics: Step-by-step breakdown of analysis and synthesis compiler phases.

cases.subject: SPOS
cases.query: What is the role of a lexical analyzer or scanner in compilation?
cases.expected_characteristics: Group characters into tokens, strip whitespace, and produce token stream.

cases.subject: SPOS
cases.query: Differentiate between top-down parsing and bottom-up parsing techniques.
cases.expected_characteristics: Constructing parse trees from root vs reducing leaves to start symbol.

cases.subject: SPOS
cases.query: What information is stored inside a Process Control Block (PCB)?
cases.expected_characteristics: Enumeration of PCB fields and their role in context switching.

cases.subject: SPOS
cases.query: Compare CPU scheduling algorithms FCFS, SJF, and Round Robin.
cases.expected_characteristics: Comparison of turnaround time, waiting time, convoy effect, and preemption.

cases.subject: SPOS
cases.query: Explain inter-process communication (IPC) using shared memory and message passing.
cases.expected_characteristics: Direct memory mapping vs kernel mediated message passing mechanisms.

cases.subject: SPOS
cases.query: State the three requirements to solve the critical section problem in process synchronization.
cases.expected_characteristics: Mutual exclusion, progress, and bounded waiting definitions.

cases.subject: SPOS
cases.query: What are the four Coffman conditions necessary for a deadlock to occur?
cases.expected_characteristics: The 4 simultaneous conditions that result in deadlock.

cases.subject: SPOS
cases.query: How does Banker's algorithm achieve deadlock avoidance using safe state testing?
cases.expected_characteristics: Data structures and safety algorithm check prior to granting requests.

cases.subject: SPOS
cases.query: Explain paging in memory management and the role of the TLB.
cases.expected_characteristics: Address translation from page to frame and hardware caching via TLB.

cases.subject: SPOS
cases.query: Compare FIFO, LRU, and Optimal page replacement algorithms and Belady's anomaly.
cases.expected_characteristics: Tradeoffs between eviction policies and frame allocation behavior.

cases.subject: SPOS
cases.query: Explain disk scheduling algorithms SSTF and SCAN for minimizing head seek time.
cases.expected_characteristics: Head trajectory optimization to service pending cylinder requests.

cases.subject: CN
cases.query: Explain the 7 layers of the OSI reference model and compare with TCP/IP model.
cases.expected_characteristics: Layer duties from physical bits to application layer services.

cases.subject: CN
cases.query: Compare star network topology and mesh network topology in terms of fault tolerance.
cases.expected_characteristics: Single point of failure at hub vs dedicated point-to-point links.

cases.subject: CN
cases.query: How does Cyclic Redundancy Check (CRC) detect transmission errors in data link frames?
cases.expected_characteristics: Modulo-2 binary division by generator polynomial appending remainder.

cases.subject: CN
cases.query: Compare Go-Back-N and Selective Repeat sliding window ARQ protocols.
cases.expected_characteristics: Cumulative ACK retransmission of entire window vs individual ACKs.

cases.subject: CN
cases.query: Explain IPv4 classful addressing vs CIDR subnetting and subnet masks.
cases.expected_characteristics: Fixed classes A-C vs variable prefix length masks for IP conservation.

cases.subject: CN
cases.query: Compare Distance Vector Routing and Link State Routing algorithms.
cases.expected_characteristics: Neighbor table exchange vs global topology flooding with shortest path.

cases.subject: CN
cases.query: What are the main differences between TCP and UDP protocols?
cases.expected_characteristics: Reliable connection 3-way handshake vs lightweight connectionless datagrams.

cases.subject: CN
cases.query: Explain the role of DNS and DHCP protocols in the application layer.
cases.expected_characteristics: Domain name resolution to IP addresses and automatic IP configuration.

cases.subject: DBMS
cases.query: Explain the Three-Schema Architecture of a database management system.
cases.expected_characteristics: Separation of physical storage, conceptual entities, and user views.

cases.subject: DBMS
cases.query: Describe the components of an Entity-Relationship (ER) diagram.
cases.expected_characteristics: Entity types, attribute classifications, and cardinality ratios.

cases.subject: DBMS
cases.query: What are the fundamental operations in relational algebra?
cases.expected_characteristics: Unary sigma/pi and binary set union, difference, and cross product.

cases.subject: DBMS
cases.query: Explain 1NF, 2NF, 3NF, and BCNF normal forms in database normalization.
cases.expected_characteristics: Removal of multivalued attributes, partial dependencies, and transitive dependencies.

cases.subject: DBMS
cases.query: Explain the ACID properties of a database transaction.
cases.expected_characteristics: All-or-nothing execution, integrity constraints, isolation, and persistence.

cases.subject: DBMS
cases.query: How does Two-Phase Locking (2PL) guarantee serializability in transactions?
cases.expected_characteristics: Lock acquisition before release preventing conflicting schedules.

cases.subject: TOC
cases.query: Compare Deterministic Finite Automata (DFA) and Non-deterministic Finite Automata (NFA).
cases.expected_characteristics: Deterministic single target state vs transition to power set of states.

cases.subject: TOC
cases.query: What is the difference between Moore machines and Mealy machines?
cases.expected_characteristics: Output determined by current state vs output determined by state and input.

cases.subject: TOC
cases.query: State the Pumping Lemma for regular languages and explain how it is used.
cases.expected_characteristics: String decomposition conditions used for contradiction proofs of non-regularity.

cases.subject: TOC
cases.query: Explain Context-Free Grammars (CFG) and Pushdown Automata (PDA).
cases.expected_characteristics: Grammar production rules and stack augmented automata for CFL recognition.

cases.subject: TOC
cases.query: Describe a Turing Machine and explain why the Halting Problem is undecidable.
cases.expected_characteristics: Infinite tape automaton and formal undecidability proof of program termination.
